import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

// Badge is referenced only from JSX: no-unused-vars must count that use (react/jsx-uses-vars).
function Badge({ label }: { label: string }) {
  return <span>{label}</span>;
}

export function Panel({ items }: { items: string[] }) {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(items.length);
  useEffect(() => {
    const handle = setTimeout(() => setCount(items.length), 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(handle);
  }, [items]);
  return (
    <ul>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item}>
          <Badge label={item} />
        </li>
      ))}
      <li>{count}</li>
    </ul>
  );
}
